content.short: Router Nitro is an intent-based cross-chain bridge offering sub-15-second transfers at 50%+ lower gas costs than traditional bridges.
content.description: Router Nitro by Router Protocol is an intent-based bridging solution that leverages a network of solver market makers to fulfill cross-chain transfer requests with exceptional speed and cost efficiency  settling in under 15 seconds with gas costs up to 50% lower than traditional bridge architectures. By using an intent model instead of lock-and-mint, Nitro avoids the latency and fees of standard bridge mechanisms. The protocol is deployed on Mantle and supports a wide range of token and chain combinations.
content.meta: Router Nitro is a fast, gas-optimized intent-based bridge for cross-chain transfers to and from Mantle. Discover Router Nitro on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
